beaches.name: Caves Beach (Paralia Spilies)
beaches.summary: Naturist use of this hidden cove between Chrani and Kalamaki is reported. A naturist directory describes a quiet naturist beach reached by a field path and rock scramble, with visits noted in 2015 (path not found) and September 2020 (path maintained, beach very quiet). No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Glossa (Secret Beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual across this small cove beside Voidokilia. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2013 to 2022 describing the cove as nudist with some clothed visitors; a 2019 Greek listicle also lists it. Reached by a 10-minute path past the Tholos tomb.

beaches.name: Romanos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported north and south of the Costa Navarino resort. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to 2022; the used spots shift with resort and beach-bar activity, and guests keep to the central section. No designation is documented.

beaches.name: Voidokilia
beaches.summary: Visitor reports from 2020 and 2022 find no opportunity for nude bathing. A naturist directory carried a relaxed mixed report in 2010 but its recent reports say the bay is now too busy from both access points, while a travel page still calls the far end an unofficial naturist zone. Sources conflict.

beaches.name: Finikounda (west beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing mid-beach is reported lost since a beach bar opened in 2020. A naturist directory carries reports of a long-standing naturist section from 2002 to 2019; its 2020-2021 reports find the section gone, with a single nude couple left among the crowds. A naturist villa complex operates nearby.

beaches.name: Kalamaki (Finikounda-Koroni)
beaches.summary: Visitors report being told in 2021 to dress and leave this cove. A naturist directory reports a painted-over nude-beach sign in September 2020 and locals ordering nudists off in July 2021; naturist accommodation formerly operated nearby.

beaches.name: Kantouni
beaches.summary: Occasional nude bathing is reported at this small cove east of Finikounda. A naturist directory carries an August 2019 report of two nudist couples and a July 2021 report that nudity was possible with no other nudists present. Boats and paddle-boarders call at the cove.

beaches.name: Trahila / Kataphygi rocks
beaches.summary: Nude bathing from the rocks is reported south of Agios Dimitrios, toward Trahila. A naturist directory carries reports from 2011 (naked and clothed bathers roughly half and half) and September 2020 (mixed but predominantly naked). Rock platforms rather than a beach; partly visible from the road.
